title: Replace core switch SW-HQ-CORE-01
description: Swap the ageing core switch for the new chassis, migrating uplinks in pairs.
reason_for_change: End of support in November and two PSU alerts this quarter.
test_plan: Failover test on each uplink pair before moving the next.
rollback_plan: Roll back by re-patching uplinks to the old chassis, which stays racked for 7 days.

title: Apply July security patch baseline to servers
description: Monthly patch ring across all server groups.
test_plan: Patch the pilot ring first and check application smoke tests.
rollback_plan: Uninstall the patch bundle and reboot.

title: Enable conditional access for legacy protocols
description: Block legacy auth except for two named service accounts.
reason_for_change: Closes the credential-stuffing route flagged in the pen test.
test_plan: Report-only mode for a week, then enforce.
rollback_plan: Set the policy back to report-only.

title: Install depot switch at Leeds
description: New 24-port PoE switch for the mezzanine extension.
reason_for_change: Fifteen new scanner docks need wired uplinks.
test_plan: Verify PoE budget and VLAN trunking before cutover.
rollback_plan: Leave the existing switch in place; no user impact until patched.

title: Migrate file shares to Brookmere cloud storage
description: Phase 1: move the tender and marketing libraries.
reason_for_change: Capacity relief on SRV-FILE01 and better offsite recovery.
test_plan: Copy, verify checksums, run in parallel for a week.
rollback_plan: Repoint the DFS namespace back to the on-premise target.

title: Decommission legacy AS400 gateway
description: Retire the gateway once the last finance extract is migrated.
reason_for_change: Contract CTR-2026-010 has expired and the platform is unsupported.
test_plan: Confirm 30 days with no traffic on the gateway interface.
rollback_plan: Power the gateway back on; config is backed up.

title: Firmware upgrade for wifi APs to 9.4
description: Fixes the fast-roam bug behind the warehouse scanner problem.
reason_for_change: Known error WX-4471 affects picking productivity daily.
test_plan: Upgrade two APs in aisle 7 and run a full picking shift before the rest.
rollback_plan: Downgrade to 9.2 from the local image store.

title: Add index to Sage posting table
description: Create the covering index identified in the month-end problem investigation.
test_plan: Create ONLINE, then re-run the three slowest reports.

title: Emergency reboot of SRV-APP02 after AV quarantine
description: Service restart and reboot after the antivirus quarantined a DLL in use.
reason_for_change: Application down for all users; approved verbally by the duty manager.
test_plan: Smoke test the application login and a test transaction.
rollback_plan: Restore the quarantined file from the AV vault.

title: Rotate service account credentials (quarterly)
description: Quarterly rotation for the eight monitored service accounts.
test_plan: Rotate one account at a time and confirm dependent services.
rollback_plan: Restore the previous credential from the vault.

title: Replace HQ comms room air-con unit
description: Marlbrook to replace the failing unit; portable cooling in place meanwhile.
reason_for_change: Repeated temperature alarms risk an unplanned shutdown.
test_plan: Monitor the probe for 48 hours after commissioning.
rollback_plan: Keep the portable unit on site for a fortnight.

title: Term-time change freeze for Cranbourne Academy Trust
description: Administrative change recording the agreed freeze window.

title: Upgrade ITSM database server to SQL 2022
description: In-place upgrade of SQLDB-ITSM with a full backup taken first.
test_plan: Restore the backup to a test instance and upgrade there first.

title: Enable disk quotas on shared drives
description: Apply 200GB soft quotas per department share.
reason_for_change: Prevents a repeat of the file server capacity incident.

title: Roll out new standard laptop build (Win11 24H2)
description: New image with the updated security baseline and Sage client preinstalled.
reason_for_change: Reduces new-starter setup from 4 hours to 40 minutes.
test_plan: Ten pilot devices across three departments for a fortnight.
rollback_plan: Continue issuing the previous image; both remain available.
